name: design-skills
title: Design skills
description: Twenty-three verified design cards for web, image, social post visuals, motion graphics, video editing, cutting, color, audio, noise removal, restoration, captions, and delivery, plus twelve craft cards, seven lesson cards (hook speech match, mixed-script captions, talk edit and layers, signed-output release, cross-surface takeaways, caption and video QC, Arabic text and mirroring), sixteen web-craft cards (anti-generic lint, motion tokens, GSAP web motion, micro-polish, diagram design, measured web type, spacing and grid, colour tokens, WCAG 2.2, UI motion review, three.js post, social proof, nav and pricing layout, OG image, CSS cascade safety, SEO and AI-answer-engine basics), four video-craft cards (Shorts safe area, film review and sound, grade and loudness map, caption files and titles), a stills card, a data-viz card, two slides cards (Arabic PPTX, pptxgenjs), one recon-craft card (app map, feature gap, complaint themes) and a zero-LLM QC script.
useWhen: designing a web surface, image, motion graphic, or video, or checking one against objective quality gates
